description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LeavePermissionTrait' used within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides a method to check if a leave entry is accessible based on user roles and permissions, enforcing security access controls tied to employee identification.

methods.name: checkLeaveAccessible
methods.description: Checks if a leave record is accessible to the current user based on role and permissions. Throws an exception if the check fails.
